title: Canonical web discovery metadata and sitemap
objective: Make the already-published static Deskal website self-describing to browsers and search crawlers through exact canonical URL metadata, Open Graph URL/site identity, and a deterministic sitemap, without adding analytics, tracking, dynamic services, custom DNS, release mutation, installer changes, or any Deskal runtime authority.

include: absolute canonical metadata for the canonical GitHub Pages URL
evidence-bounded Open Graph URL and site-name metadata
a deterministic static sitemap containing only the canonical Deskal Pages URL
web regression tests that pin the canonical URL and prevent alternate origins or dynamic discovery surfaces
static-export build qualification and post-deployment HTTPS verification of the canonical page and sitemap
exclude: analytics, telemetry, tracking, cookies, pixels, third-party scripts, or hosted observability
robots control for the thehalfmoon.github.io domain root, which this project page does not own
creating, editing, publishing, deleting, or retagging any GitHub Release or tag
authentication, forms, payments, hosted APIs, databases, or other dynamic services
installer changes, package publication, artifact distribution changes, or compatibility identifier migration
changes to Deskal runtime, MCP tools, policy, approvals, trust, leases, providers, browser authority, desktop authority, filesystem authority, network authority, or process authority

authority_delta.filesystem: Static website metadata source, sitemap source, and web regression tests only; no Deskal runtime filesystem authority change.
authority_delta.network: No Deskal runtime network authority. Qualification may read the already-public canonical Pages URL and sitemap over HTTPS.

invariants: the canonical public origin remains exactly https://thehalfmoon.github.io/Deskal/
the sitemap contains no alternate host, dynamic endpoint, release asset, user-specific path, or secret-bearing value
metadata is static build input and grants no Deskal authority
no telemetry, analytics, tracking, authentication, payment, form, hosted backend, custom domain, or DNS surface is introduced
GitHub Releases, tags, repository settings, Pages build mode, and Deskal runtime/MCP source remain unchanged

acceptance.claim: The website emits one absolute canonical URL exactly equal to https://thehalfmoon.github.io/Deskal/ and pins the same URL in Open Graph metadata with site name Deskal.
A deterministic static sitemap is produced with exactly one URL, https://thehalfmoon.github.io/Deskal/, and no timestamps or runtime-dependent values.
Web regression tests fail on alternate origins, extra sitemap URLs, dynamic discovery behavior, tracking/analytics additions, or direct release-artifact links.
The isolated web typecheck, tests, and static export build pass with the existing /Deskal project base path and runtime workspaces remain unchanged.
Post-deployment HTTPS verification confirms the canonical page and /Deskal/sitemap.xml return successfully without changing Pages configuration or DNS.

Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of exclusions, zero unresolved blocking review threads, normal merge, and post-merge CI complete before canonical closeout.

successor_requirements.release_or_tag_change: Any release or tag mutation requires separately authorized successor work.
successor_requirements.custom_domain: Any custom domain or DNS change requires separately authorized successor work.
successor_requirements.dynamic_service: Any analytics, telemetry, form, auth, payment, API, database, or hosted dynamic service requires separately authorized successor work.

done_when: Canonical and Open Graph URL metadata plus a deterministic one-URL sitemap are merged and qualified, the static Pages deployment serves the canonical page and sitemap over HTTPS, excluded surfaces remain unchanged, and post-merge CI is green.
